swarm.code:
from codrone_edu.drone import *
import time
import threading

drone1 = Drone()
drone2 = Drone()
drone3 = Drone()

drone1.pair()
drone2.pair()
drone3.pair()

time.sleep(2)

def fly_drone1():
    d = drone1
    d.takeoff()
    d.move_forward(80, speed=0.7)
    d.circle(speed=75, direction=1)
    d.land()

def fly_drone2():
    d = drone2
    d.takeoff()
    d.move_right(60, speed=0.5)
    d.land()

def fly_drone3():
    d = drone3
    d.takeoff()
    d.move_forward(120, speed=0.9)
    d.turn_right(90)
    d.move_forward(80, speed=0.9)
    d.land()

threads = []
t1 = threading.Thread(target=fly_drone1)
threads.append(t1)
t2 = threading.Thread(target=fly_drone2)
threads.append(t2)
t3 = threading.Thread(target=fly_drone3)
threads.append(t3)

for t in threads:
    t.start()
for t in threads:
    t.join()

drone1.close()
drone2.close()
drone3.close()
